title: Whisker Blademaster
html:
Whisker Blademaster

Whisker Blademasters are tall Whiskers who wield two swords. They charge into combat usually Stunning or knocking their opponent down.

Race: Whisker

Class: Melee

Tip: Very often, especially in lowel level dungeons, Blademasters can do massive damage quickly and may be your most serious opponent. Try to take them out first. If several surround you, use an AoE skill.

Specials

Rattle Tooth's Vengeful Blademasters appear in Rattle Tooth's Revenge when Rattle Tooth's Ghost is slain. Sissirat's Vengeful Blademasters appear in Sissirat's Revenge when Sissirat's Ghost is slain. Vergrim's Vengeful Blademasters appear in Vergrim's Revenge when Vergrim's Ghost is slain.

Uniques

  • Rattle Toe is a Champion who shares Sissirat's Lair.
  • Rattle Tooth's Relatives and Rattle Tooth's Family Friends occupy higher level dungeons. They get progressively stronger as the dungeon level gets higher.
  • Dr. Richard Choppe is a Divine Whisker Blademaster Hero who will be found in Choppe's Shoppe off of Level 7 of Frump's Misfortune.

Behavior

  • Whisker Blademasters have a variety of moves at their disposal, which are:
    • A holy roller-like attack which can knock you down for 2-5 seconds
    • A butcher-like attack which deals vicious damage to low levels
    • And their normal attack, a sweeping blow with their scimitars.
